sections.Profile:
Tally Hoo!!, released by Peyper of Madrid in 1977, is a single-player electro-mechanical game from the company's first year of production. Peyper built it with score-reel scoring and also in a version with an LED display mounted in front of the reels.

- Manufacturer: Peyper
- Years made: 1977
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Sports, Dogs, Horses, Original Theme, Hunting, 1970s, Animals
